evidence: Version, copyright and declared license are recorded from the committed font name tables; SHA-256 covers the exact committed file bytes. Each font matches its immutable upstream Git blob ID and byte size through anonymous verified HTTPS metadata. The five smaller Arabic and core font files also match anonymously downloaded upstream bytes by SHA-256. This identifies byte-equivalent upstream sources, not the original ingestion date or operator.
